functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_avancar_esteira_laboratorio(p_os_id uuid, p_origem text, p_etapa_destino text, p_programacao_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'manual' OR p_etapa_destino IS DISTINCT FROM 'enviar_cq' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CQ_OPERATION_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN platform_private.manual_cq_v1(p_os_id,p_programacao_id,NULL);
END $function$

functions.name: public.rpc_avancar_esteira_laboratorio
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_avancar_esteira_laboratorio(p_os_id uuid, p_origem text, p_etapa_destino text, p_programacao_id uuid, p_cq jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'manual' OR p_etapa_destino IS DISTINCT FROM 'registrar_cq' OR p_cq IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CQ_OPERATION_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN platform_private.manual_cq_v1(p_os_id,p_programacao_id,p_cq);
END $function$
